items.title: Likhang Filipino Theatre in Pasay opens its doors
items.description: President Marcos and First Lady Liza Marcos on Friday inaugurated the 279-seat Likhang Filipino Theatre along Roxas Boulevard in Pasay, a new hub for artists to showcase their work and support the Philippines’ creative industry.

items.title: Groups back DFA on sustained talks with China
items.description: A total of 20 labor, business and civil society organizations expressed support for the call of the Department of Foreign Affairs to sustain dialogue and cooperation with China, citing its importance in advancing national interest and promoting economic growth.

items.title: PAGASA monitors ‘Cempaka’

items.title: Jonvic wants BJMP explanation on Romualdez aide
items.description: Officials from the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas are in hot water for allowing a personal staff of former speaker Martin Romualdez to stay with him around the clock in his cell.

items.title: Experts push passage of hospital nutrition care bill
items.description: Experts are pushing for the passage of a bill institutionalizing nutrition care in all public and private hospitals nationwide, saying standardized services could help identify nutritional risks early, improve patient recovery and reduce complications.

items.title: DND chief honors Philippines, US war veterans
items.description: Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro Jr. paid tribute to Filipino and American veterans yesterday for their sacrifices and service in defense of their respective countries, emphasizing the responsibility of present generations to preserve the freedoms and shared values they fought for.

items.title: DepEd to prioritize first-time recipients in MacBook rollout
items.description: The Department of Education will prioritize public school teachers who have never received a government- or school-issued laptop in the rollout of 231,725 newly procured devices, Education Secretary Sonny Angara vowed yesterday.

items.title: No Pax Silica announcement during ASEAN – US envoy
items.description: There are no plans for the signing of agreements on Pax Silica at the coming Association of Southeast Asian Nations Leaders’ Summit in Manila later this month contrary to media reports, US Ambassador Lee Lipton clarified yesterday.

items.title: Prosecution had its chance, but failed – VP Sara
items.description: The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte said the House prosecution team “had its chance but failed” in her Senate impeachment trial as the defense team takes its turn to present its evidence and witnesses beginning tomorrow.
